description: The sprints waiting in a project board's trash: each deleted sprint with its name, goal, state and days as they were, 'deletedAt', 'deletedBy' and 'purgeAt' — when it is deleted for good, 30 days after. 'issues' is how many it held; 'back' names those in the backlog now (restore_sprint brings them back with it), 'elsewhere' those that went into another sprint since, with where they lie; 'gone' and 'hidden' count the deleted ones and those of projects you cannot open. 'canRestore' says whether you may restore. Any member may read it.

projectKey.description: Project key whose board's trash to read, e.g. 'PM'.
